name: ICU Medical, Inc.
summary: ICU Medical, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells medical products used in infusion therapy, vascular access, and vital care applications worldwide. It offers Clave needlefree products under the MicroClave, MicroClave Clear, and NanoClave brands; Neutron catheter patency devices; ChemoLock closed system transfer devices and ChemoClaveTM for preparation and administration of hazardous drugs; Tego needle free connectors; Deltec GRIPPER non-coring needles for portal access; ClearGuard, SwabCap, and SwabTip disinfection caps; and vascular access products.
